sections.heading: 1. Sit-to-stands
lines: ① Sit on a chair, stand up slowly, no hands.
② Sit back down slowly, 10 × 2 sets.
③ Step-ups on the bottom stair, × 10.
④ Start with a 10–20 min walk daily.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: Pain after a fall or twist

caption:
Stairs make Koko's knee twinge, and he wondered about another scan. Hybi's answer was a little different.

X-ray changes and pain often don't match well. Another scan usually won't change what helps day to day.

Current guidelines recommend exercise and education first for knee osteoarthritis. Joints are built to be loaded, and resting too much often makes stiffness worse. Hybi's 1-minute routine: sit-to-stands with no hands, 10 × 2 sets, step-ups on the bottom stair × 10, and a daily 10–20 minute walk.

A hot, very swollen knee, one that locks or gives way, or pain after a fall needs a prompt assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐨
